name: soft-key-door-box
task: Take the key, then open the door. After that, try to pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) hard with Precedence(has_door_key, door_open) hard captures 'Take the key, then open the door' and forces the key; Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard keeps the 'After that' order (the preference cue 'try to' scopes only 'pick up the box', not the order word), and the soft Existence(target_picked_up) captures 'try to pick up the box'. The machine confirms this: every finish includes has_door_key and door_open, and the box pickup adds reward without being required.

texts: The matching door key must be acquired before the door is opened.
The target box must be picked up only after the door is opened.
If possible, pick up the target box.
